headline: Red Wings activate Marco Kasper, Mason Appleton off IR
take:
Daily Faceoff reports the Red Wings have activated Marco Kasper and Mason Appleton off injured reserve. Kasper has missed all but one game this season, while Appleton has missed all but two.

The samples are tiny, so treat these as hints. In his one game, Kasper played 10.83 minutes and the Red Wings controlled 71% of the 5-on-5 chance quality (expected goals, our measure of how good a team's shots are) with him on the ice. Appleton sits at 73% over two games. Detroit as a whole is at 53% at 5-on-5 so far this season, so both skaters pushed play well above the team norm in limited work. The Wings are 7-8-3, and their goals scored trail the quality of their chances by 11.1, so a healthier forward group could help close that gap. Kasper, the eighth pick in 2022, scored 9 goals last season and is worth a look as depth in deeper fantasy leagues once his minutes settle. We'd watch whether either forward moves above the 10-minute mark in the coming games.
